name: evakage
description: Temporary, end-to-end encrypted browser chat and file sharing for trusted networks.
author: thesteau

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:go && node --test "dist/tests/unit/*.test.js"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config dist/app/playwright.config.js
scripts.test:e2e:platform: npm run build && playwright test --config dist/app/playwright.platform.config.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:release && node ../scripts/go.mjs vet ./... && npm test && npm run test:release
